title: Conservation outcomes of dietary transitions across different values of nature
abstract: Conservation benefits from dietary change are commonly assessed without accounting for different conservation objectives. By representing fine-scale habitat and landscape change within a dynamic land-system model, we assess how a partial or full transition to healthier diets would affect indicators across the ‘Nature for Nature’ and ‘Nature for Society’ conservation value perspectives. We find that most diet-related conservation benefits are already achieved by a partial shift to healthier diets. This is because, particularly in many countries in tropical Africa and Asia, adopting healthier diets would mainly involve substituting staple foods with more varied plant-based foods rather than replacing resource-intensive livestock products. Conservation action in line with the Global Biodiversity Framework, by contrast, most consistently improves outcomes across both value perspectives, even under current demand trends, showing that spatial planning is central for decoupling conservation outcomes from food demand. However, any progress towards healthier diets not only lowers greenhouse gas emissions but also reduces barriers to effective conservation, such as higher food prices and imports.
abstract_zh: 饮食变革带来的保护效益通常在评估时并未考虑不同的保护目标。通过在动态土地系统模型中刻画精细尺度的栖息地和景观变化，我们评估了部分或全面转向更健康饮食将如何影响“为自然而保护”和“为社会而保护”两种保护价值视角下的各项指标。我们发现，大多数与饮食相关的保护效益已经可以通过部分转向更健康饮食实现。这是因为，特别是在热带非洲和亚洲的许多国家，采用更健康的饮食主要意味着以种类更丰富的植物性食物替代主食，而非取代资源密集型的畜产品。相比之下，符合《全球生物多样性框架》的保护行动，即使在当前需求趋势下，也能在两种价值视角下最一致地改善结果，这表明空间规划对于使保护成果与食物需求脱钩至关重要。然而，任何朝向更健康饮食的进展，不仅降低温室气体排放，还减少了有效保护的障碍，例如食品价格上涨和进口增加。

title: Earth-Economy Modeling: Advances in Linking Economic and Ecosystem Models
abstract: This article reviews a wide range of models that integrate ecological and economic systems, presenting Earth-Economy (EE) modeling as a general approach for sustainable management in these contexts. EE models combine global, general equilibrium economic models with high-resolution Earth system models and include two-way linkages between Earth systems and the economy, enabling data-focused decision support for sustainability. We conduct a systematic review of models related to this domain, create a typology of relevant models, and discuss the interconnections between them. We include a detailed definition of EE modeling and discuss how the relevant models can be integrated and extended to improve the comprehensiveness with which we model sustainability. This review shows both the importance of and associated challenges, but also the high demand, for this type of model.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了一系列整合生态与经济系统的模型，并将地球—经济（EE）建模作为这些情境下可持续管理的一种通用方法加以介绍。EE模型将全球一般均衡经济模型与高分辨率地球系统模型相结合，包含地球系统与经济之间的双向联系，从而为可持续发展提供以数据为基础的决策支持。我们对该领域的相关模型进行了系统综述，建立了相关模型的类型学，并讨论了它们之间的相互联系。我们给出了EE建模的详细定义，并探讨了如何整合和扩展相关模型，以提高我们对可持续性建模的全面性。本综述既表明了这类模型的重要性和相关挑战，也显示了对其的巨大需求。

title: Land use strategies for achieving Chile's nationally determined contributions
abstract: Chile’s Nationally determined contributions (NDCs) commit to carbon neutrality by 2050, with measures to reduce emissions and natural hazards while enhancing water security. The Forestry and Other Land Uses (FOLU) sectors are critical to Chile’s goal of carbon neutrality, as they serve as a net carbon sink. In this paper, we conduct policy scenario analysis focusing on FOLU strategies for meeting the NDCs. We implement the Integrated Economic-Environmental Modeling framework linked with spatial Land Use-Land Cover and Ecosystem Services (ES) Modeling (IEEM + ESM) to assess impacts on economic, environmental and social indicators. Our results show that the implementation of Chile’s FOLU strategies would reduce emissions, enhance wealth and economic growth and increase future flows of ES. Carbon dioxide emissions would be reduced (by 151 million tons by 2050) to levels that would be considerably better than current Government expectations. Gross Domestic Product and wealth would be bolstered by US$16 065 million and US$22 731 million, respectively. Water-related ES would improve including the quality of potable water, while more water would be maintained within forested ecosystems, thereby reducing the future risk of natural hazards such as landslides and floods. The FOLU strategies would create 72 800 new jobs and reduce poverty by 15 586 individuals. Analysis with IEEM + ESM demonstrates that reducing wildfire-driven forest loss would have outsized impacts and be the most effective and expedient way to contribute to meeting NDC targets. The IEEM + ESM approach is an example of an analytical framework that is meeting growing demand from Government institutions and multilateral development banks for understanding the effects and transition pathways of NDC strategies on economic, social and environmental outcomes.
abstract_zh: 智利的国家自主贡献（NDCs）承诺到2050年实现碳中和，并采取措施减少排放和自然灾害，同时增强水安全。林业和其他土地利用（FOLU）部门对智利实现碳中和目标至关重要，因为它们是净碳汇。本文中，我们针对实现国家自主贡献的FOLU战略开展了政策情景分析。我们运用与空间土地利用—土地覆盖及生态系统服务（ES）模型相连接的综合经济—环境建模框架（IEEM + ESM），评估其对经济、环境和社会指标的影响。结果表明，智利FOLU战略的实施将减少排放、增加财富并促进经济增长，并增加未来的生态系统服务流量。到2050年，二氧化碳排放量将减少1.51亿吨，其水平将明显优于政府当前的预期。国内生产总值和财富将分别增加160.65亿美元和227.31亿美元。与水相关的生态系统服务将得到改善，包括饮用水质量的提高，同时更多的水将保留在森林生态系统中，从而降低滑坡和洪水等自然灾害的未来风险。FOLU战略将创造72800个新就业岗位，并使15586人脱离贫困。IEEM + ESM的分析表明，减少由野火导致的森林损失将产生显著的超比例影响，是实现国家自主贡献目标最有效、最迅速的途径。IEEM + ESM方法是一个分析框架的范例，它正满足政府机构和多边开发银行日益增长的需求，即理解国家自主贡献战略在经济、社会和环境结果方面的效果及转型路径。

title: Biodiversity loss reduces global terrestrial carbon storage
abstract:
Natural ecosystems store large amounts of carbon globally, as organisms absorb carbon from the atmosphere to build large, long-lasting, or slow-decaying structures such as tree bark or root systems. An ecosystem’s carbon sequestration potential is tightly linked to its biological diversity. Yet when considering future projections, many carbon sequestration models fail to account for the role biodiversity plays in carbon storage. Here, we assess the consequences of plant biodiversity loss for carbon storage under multiple climate and land-use change scenarios. We link a macroecological model projecting changes in vascular plant richness under different scenarios with empirical data on relationships between biodiversity and biomass. We find that biodiversity declines from climate and land use change could lead to a global loss of between
7.44-103.14
PgC (global sustainability scenario) and
10.87-145.95
PgC (fossil-fueled development scenario). This indicates a self-reinforcing feedback loop, where higher levels of climate change lead to greater biodiversity loss, which in turn leads to greater carbon emissions and ultimately more climate change. Conversely, biodiversity conservation and restoration can help achieve climate change mitigation goals.
abstract_zh: 天然生态系统在全球范围内储存了大量碳，因为生物体从大气中吸收碳，构建出大型、持久或缓慢分解的结构，例如树皮或根系。生态系统的碳封存潜力与其生物多样性密切相关。然而，在对未来进行预测时，许多碳封存模型并未考虑生物多样性在碳储存中的作用。在此，我们评估了在多种气候和土地利用变化情景下，植物生物多样性丧失对碳储存的后果。我们将预测不同情景下维管植物丰富度变化的宏观生态模型，与生物多样性和生物量之间关系的实证数据相联系。我们发现，气候和土地利用变化导致的生物多样性下降，可能使全球碳储量损失在7.44至103.14 PgC之间（全球可持续发展情景），以及在10.87至145.95 PgC之间（化石燃料驱动发展情景）。这表明存在一种自我强化的反馈循环：气候变化程度越高，导致生物多样性丧失越多，进而造成更多碳排放，并最终加剧气候变化。反之，生物多样性保护与恢复有助于实现气候变化缓解目标。

title: Global spatially explicit yield gap time trends reveal regions at risk of future crop yield stagnation
abstract: Yield gaps, here defined as the difference between actual and attainable yields, provide a framework for assessing opportunities to increase agricultural productivity. Previous global assessments, centred on a single year, were unable to identify temporal variation. Here we provide a spatially and temporally comprehensive analysis of yield gaps for ten major crops from 1975 to 2010. Yield gaps have widened steadily over most areas for the eight annual crops and remained static for sugar cane and oil palm. We developed a three-category typology to differentiate regions of ‘steady growth’ in actual and attainable yields, ‘stalled floor’ where yield is stagnated and ‘ceiling pressure’ where yield gaps are closing. Over 60% of maize area is experiencing ‘steady growth’, in contrast to ∼12% for rice. Rice and wheat have 84% and 56% of area, respectively, experiencing ‘ceiling pressure’. We show that ‘ceiling pressure’ correlates with subsequent yield stagnation, signalling risks for multiple countries currently realizing gains from yield growth.
abstract_zh: 单产差距，即实际单产与可实现单产之间的差额，为评估提高农业生产率的机会提供了一个框架。以往以单一年份为基础的全球评估，无法识别时间变化。在此，我们对1975至2010年间十种主要作物的单产差距进行了空间和时间上全面的分析。在大多数地区，八种一年生作物的单产差距持续扩大，而甘蔗和油棕的单产差距则保持稳定。我们建立了三类类型学，以区分实际与可实现单产呈“稳步增长”的地区、单产陷入停滞的“平台期”地区，以及单产差距正在缩小的“天花板压力”地区。超过60%的玉米种植面积处于“稳步增长”状态，而水稻仅约为12%。水稻和小麦分别有84%和56%的种植面积处于“天花板压力”状态。我们发现，“天花板压力”与随后的单产停滞相关，这对当前仍在从单产增长中获益的多个国家而言，预示着潜在风险。

title: Global trends and scenarios for terrestrial biodiversity and ecosystem services from 1900 to 2050
abstract: Based on an extensive model intercomparison, we assessed trends in biodiversity and ecosystem services from historical reconstructions and future scenarios of land-use and climate change. During the 20th century, biodiversity declined globally by 2 to 11%, as estimated by a range of indicators. Provisioning ecosystem services increased several fold, and regulating services decreased moderately. Going forward, policies toward sustainability have the potential to slow biodiversity loss resulting from land-use change and the demand for provisioning services while reducing or reversing declines in regulating services. However, negative impacts on biodiversity due to climate change appear poised to increase, particularly in the higher-emissions scenarios. Our assessment identifies remaining modeling uncertainties but also robustly shows that renewed policy efforts are needed to meet the goals of the Convention on Biological Diversity.
abstract_zh: 基于广泛的模型比较，我们根据土地利用和气候变化的历史重建与未来情景，评估了生物多样性和生态系统服务的变化趋势。20世纪期间，按照多种指标估算，全球生物多样性下降了2%至11%。供给型生态系统服务增长了数倍，而调节型服务则出现了适度下降。展望未来，可持续发展政策有潜力减缓土地利用变化和对供给型服务需求所导致的生物多样性丧失，同时减少或扭转调节型服务的下降。然而，气候变化对生物多样性的负面影响似乎将加剧，特别是在高排放情景下。我们的评估指出了仍然存在的模型不确定性，但也有力地表明，需要重新加强政策努力，以实现《生物多样性公约》的目标。

title: Integrated modeling of nature's role in human well-being: A research agenda
Mapping the planet's critical areas for biodiversity and nature's contributions to people
abstract: Meeting global commitments to conservation, climate, and sustainable development requires consideration of synergies and tradeoffs among targets. We evaluate the spatial congruence of ecosystems providing globally high levels of nature’s contributions to people, biodiversity, and areas with high development potential across several sectors. We find that conserving approximately half of global land area through protection or sustainable management could provide 90% of the current levels of ten of nature’s contributions to people and meet minimum representation targets for 26,709 terrestrial vertebrate species. This finding supports recent commitments by national governments under the Global Biodiversity Framework to conserve at least 30% of global lands and waters, and proposals to conserve half of the Earth. More than one-third of areas required for conserving nature’s contributions to people and species are also highly suitable for agriculture, renewable energy, oil and gas, mining, or urban expansion. This indicates potential conflicts among conservation, climate and development goals.
abstract_zh: 实现全球在保护、气候和可持续发展方面的承诺，需要考虑各目标之间的协同和权衡。我们评估了在多个部门中，提供全球高水平自然对人类贡献（NCP）的生态系统、生物多样性以及具有较高发展潜力的区域之间的空间一致性。我们发现，通过保护或可持续管理约一半的全球陆地面积，可以提供当前十项自然对人类贡献水平的90%，并满足26709种陆生脊椎动物物种的最低代表性目标。这一发现支持了各国政府在《全球生物多样性框架》下作出的承诺，即保护至少30%的全球陆地和水域，也支持了保护地球一半面积的倡议。超过三分之一为保护自然对人类的贡献和物种所需的区域，同时也非常适合农业、可再生能源、石油和天然气、采矿或城市扩张。这表明保护、气候与发展目标之间存在潜在冲突。

title: Telecoupling cannot be ignored for the forest-based carbon market
abstract: Telecoupling interactions between social–ecological systems across large, often global distances drive negative impacts from the forest-based carbon market. However, these negative impacts have been underreported and, therefore, have likely been vastly underestimated. We identify how these unintended negative impacts may occur and provide recommendations for the forest-based carbon market to better account for externalities by prioritizing positive social impact, expanding comprehensive ecological outcomes, and improving the transparency of investments. We call for a carbon market that is designed to account for its global interconnectedness.
abstract_zh: 跨越遥远（往往是全球性）距离的社会—生态系统之间的远程耦合相互作用，导致了森林碳市场的负面影响。然而，这些负面影响一直被低估，因此很可能被大大低估了。我们指出了这些意外负面影响可能发生的方式，并提出建议，要求森林碳市场通过优先考虑积极的社会影响、扩大全面的生态成果以及提高投资透明度，从而更好地计入外部性。我们呼吁建立一个能够考虑其全球相互联系性的碳市场设计。

title: Balancing land use for conservation, agriculture, and renewable energy
abstract: Demand for land is increasing due to mounting energy and development needs. Growing demand for food coupled with climate policy commitments calling for reduced greenhouse gas emissions will result in more land being used for agricultural and renewable energy development. At the same time, conserving land for biodiversity and nature’s contributions to people (NCP) is imperative for achieving international climate, sustainable development, and biodiversity goals. Meeting these interconnected objectives requires the efficient and equitable allocation of land to different sectors. We present a flexible, multiple-objective framework for using integer linear programming to strategically allocate land under climate change to mitigate threats to biodiversity and NCP while supporting development. The application of the framework at a planetary scale shows that if agriculture and renewable energy development are planned without consideration of biodiversity and NCP, future demands for land (6.2 million km2 globally) could impact nearly 1 million km2 of high-priority areas for nature, habitats of 440 threatened vertebrate species, and 21 Gt of vulnerable carbon stocks. Multi-sector planning can mitigate potential land conflict, reducing the number of species exposed by 15% and the amount of carbon loss by 19%. If development proceeds without coordinated planning, there is insufficient land available to achieve conservation and development targets. Our findings underscore the need to ensure critical areas for biodiversity, carbon storage, and NCP are conserved; reduce land demand for food and energy; meet remaining demand more efficiently through spatial targeting; and coordinate land use across sectors more intentionally, such as through multi-functional landscapes.
abstract_zh: 由于能源和发展需求不断增长，对土地的需求也在增加。粮食需求的增长，加上要求减少温室气体排放的气候政策承诺，将导致更多土地用于农业和可再生能源开发。与此同时，为生物多样性和自然对人类的贡献（NCP）保护土地，对于实现国际气候、可持续发展和生物多样性目标至关重要。满足这些相互关联的目标，需要高效、公平地在不同部门之间配置土地。我们提出了一个灵活的多目标框架，利用整数线性规划，在气候变化背景下战略性地配置土地，以减缓对生物多样性和NCP的威胁，同时支持发展。在全球尺度上的应用表明，如果农业和可再生能源开发在规划时不考虑生物多样性和NCP，未来的土地需求（全球为620万平方千米）可能影响近100万平方千米的自然高优先级区域、440种受威胁脊椎动物的栖息地，以及21吉吨的脆弱碳储量。多部门规划可以减轻潜在的土地冲突，使暴露的物种数量减少15%，碳损失量减少19%。如果发展缺乏协调规划，将没有足够的土地来同时实现保护和发展目标。我们的研究结果强调，需要确保对生物多样性、碳储存和NCP至关重要的区域得到保护；减少对粮食和能源的土地需求；通过空间定位更高效地满足剩余需求；并通过多功能景观等方式，更有意识地协调各部门的土地利用。

title: Food for Nature Payments: Global cost-efficiency optimization of payments for ecosystem services
Future food sufficiency in the face of climate and societal changes
Global Economic Impact of Wildfire Smoke
Projecting Global Changes in Land Use and Ecosystem Services Using SEALS (Spatial Economic Allocation Landscape Simulator)
abstract: Understanding how economic systems and ecosystems interact across space is crucial to ensure societal needs are met without compromising environmental quality. Spatially explicit economic models usually describe human activities and ensuing land-use dynamics at a resolution that this is too coarse (typically 10-1000 regions) to understand how these affect many biophysical processes, including ecosystem service supply (which requires billions of 300m or finer grid-cells). Several land-use change models exist that allocate coarse land-use changes at finer spatial scales, but there is no general, global, computationally tractable tool for downscaling to the spatial scale appropriate for understanding landscape and ecosystem change across different land-system scenarios. Here, we present a new model, the Spatial Economic Allocation Landscape Simulator (SEALS), which generates global, high resolution land-use, land-cover maps from coarse projections of land-use change. SEALS advances land-use change modeling research in several ways: it uses a novel machine-learning algorithm to empirically calibrate its parameters; it is a generalized approach that can be applied to very different types of projections within earth-economy models; and it is computationally efficient, generating global results at 300m resolution in approximately 1 hour on a laptop computer. We develop SEALS, and apply it to downscale 6 global scenarios of land-use change from the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) to 300m resolution, which we make publicly available, allowing researchers to project global, fine-scale changes in ecosystem services. For carbon storage and sequestration, we find that, from 2021 to 2100, the SSPs considered result in reductions in carbon storage and sequestration by 3-21%, and baseline results are 9.17% lower than conventional estimates using low-resolution inputs. Consistent with prior estimates, we find that SSPs 3 and 4, which lead to large amounts of tropical deforestation, result in the largest carbon losses, further exacerbating the climate impacts.
abstract_zh: 理解经济系统与生态系统如何跨空间相互作用，对于在不损害环境质量的前提下满足社会需求至关重要。空间显式经济模型通常以过于粗糙的分辨率（通常为10至1000个区域）描述人类活动及其引发的土地利用动态，难以理解这些活动如何影响包括生态系统服务供给在内的诸多生物物理过程（这需要数十亿个300米或更精细的网格单元）。已有若干土地利用变化模型可以将粗尺度的土地利用变化分配到更精细的空间尺度，但目前尚缺乏一种通用的、全球性的、计算上可行的降尺度工具，以达到理解不同土地系统情景下景观与生态系统变化所需的空间尺度。在此，我们提出一个新模型——空间经济分配景观模拟器（SEALS），它能够从粗略的土地利用变化预测中生成全球高分辨率的土地利用和土地覆盖图。SEALS在多个方面推进了土地利用变化建模研究：它采用一种新颖的机器学习算法对其参数进行经验校准；它是一种通用方法，可应用于地球—经济模型中各种不同类型的预测；并且计算效率很高，在一台笔记本电脑上约1小时即可生成300米分辨率的全球结果。我们开发了SEALS，并将其应用于将共享社会经济路径（SSPs）中的6种全球土地利用变化情景降尺度至300米分辨率，并将结果公开，供研究人员预测全球精细尺度的生态系统服务变化。就碳储存和碳封存而言，我们发现，从2021年到2100年，所考虑的各SSP情景将使碳储存和碳封存减少3%至21%，而基线结果比使用低分辨率输入的传统估计低9.17%。与以往估计一致，我们发现导致大量热带森林砍伐的SSP3和SSP4情景造成的碳损失最大，进一步加剧了气候影响。

title: Reversing the great degradation of nature
Spatial heterogeneity in forest carbon storage affects priorities for reforestation
abstract:
Reforestation is an important strategy for nature-based climate solutions and identifying carbon storage potential of different locations is critical to its success. Applying average carbon values from forest inventories ignores the spatial heterogeneity in forest carbon and the effects of forest edges on carbon storage degradation. Here we show how spatially-explicit, predictive carbon modeling, that leverages satellite, social and biogeophysical datasets, can be used to identify more efficient restoration opportunities for climate mitigation than area-based carbon stock averages. Accounting for regeneration of forest edges, in addition to reforestation, boosts estimates of potential carbon gains by more than 20%. The total potential carbon gain that could be achieved through reforestation at the level indicated by the Bonn Challenge (350Mha) is 51 Gt CO
2
-eq, but the “missing carbon” in our current forests accounts for 64.6 Gt CO
2
-eq globally; the greatest potential carbon gains are found in areas of high fragmentation.
abstract_zh: 再造林是基于自然的气候解决方案的重要策略，而识别不同地点的碳储存潜力对其成功至关重要。若采用森林清查的平均碳值，则忽略了森林碳的空间异质性，以及森林边缘对碳储存退化的影响。在此，我们展示了如何利用卫星、社会和生物地球物理数据集，构建空间显式的预测性碳模型，从而识别比基于面积的碳储量平均值更为高效的气候减缓恢复机会。除再造林外，考虑森林边缘的再生，可使潜在碳增益估计提高20%以上。若按照波恩挑战（Bonn Challenge）的目标（3.5亿公顷）进行再造林，可实现的潜在碳增益总量为51 Gt CO2-eq，而我们当前森林中的“缺失碳”在全球范围内达到64.6 Gt CO2-eq；最大的潜在碳增益出现在高度破碎化的地区。

abstract_zh: 尽管在理解全球生物多样性丧失方面已取得实质性进展，但在分类群和地理方面仍存在重大的知识空白。决策者常依赖专家判断来填补知识空白，却很少能够接触到足够庞大和多元化的专家群体。为了解全球数千名生物多样性专家的观点，我们开展了一项调查，要求专家聚焦于其最为熟悉的分类群以及淡水、陆地或海洋生态系统。我们发现了若干压倒性的共识（例如，多种生物多样性丧失驱动因素相互作用并产生协同效应），也发现了专家在观点和估计上存在重要的人口统计学和地理差异。来自生物多样性科学中代表性不足群体的专家，包括女性和来自全球南方的专家，对保护解决方案的优先事项提出了不同的建议，更少强调获取新的保护区，并对生物多样性丧失及其影响给出了更高的估计。这可能部分是因为他们更多地研究了受威胁最严重的分类群和栖息地。Front Ecol Environ 2022;

title: Investing in Nature Can Improve Equity and Economic Returns
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

title: Land-Use Decisions Have Substantial Air Quality Health Effects
abstract: Understanding how best to use limited land without compromising food security, health, and beneficial ecosystem functions is a critical challenge of our time. Ecosystem service assessments increasingly inform land-use decisions but seldom include the effects of land use on air quality, the largest environmental health risk. Here, we estimate and value the air quality health effects of potential land-use policies and projected trends in the United States, alongside carbon sequestration and economic returns to land, until 2051. We show that air quality health effects are of first-order importance in land-use decisions, often larger in value than carbon sequestration and economic returns combined. When air quality is properly accounted for, policies that appeared beneficial are shown to be detrimental and vice versa. Land-use-driven air quality impacts are largely from agricultural emissions and biogenic forest emissions, although incentives for reduced deforestation remain beneficial overall. Without evaluating air quality, we are unable to determine whether land-use decisions make us better or worse off.
abstract_zh: 如何在不损害粮食安全、健康和有益生态系统功能的前提下，最好地利用有限的土地，是我们这个时代的一项关键挑战。生态系统服务评估日益为土地利用决策提供信息，但很少纳入土地利用对空气质量的影响，而空气质量是最大的环境健康风险。在此，我们估算并评估了美国潜在土地利用政策及预计趋势在2051年之前对空气质量健康的影响，并与碳封存和土地经济回报进行了比较。我们表明，空气质量健康影响在土地利用决策中具有首要重要性，其价值往往超过碳封存和经济回报的总和。当充分考虑空气质量时，那些看似有益的政策会被证明是有害的，反之亦然。土地利用引起的空气质量影响主要来自农业排放和生物源森林排放，尽管减少毁林的激励措施总体上仍然有益。若不评估空气质量，我们将无法判断土地利用决策究竟使我们变得更好还是更糟。

title: Mapping the planet's critical natural assets
Modeling climate change impact on agro-ecosystem services
venue: Modelling climate change impacts on agricultural systems (Burleigh Dodds Science Publishing)
abstract: Agricultural landscapes are critical to producing food, and other ecosystem services - the vital benefits that flow from ecosystems to people. This chapter reviews how multiple ecosystem services may be impacted by climate change, broadly concluding that most impacts tend to be negative both on supporting services for agricultural production and co-benefits of agroecosystems. Systemic approaches to modeling food provision as an ecosystem service while integrating climate and societal changes are investigated; global statistical models are promising to account for climate via yields responses in “climate-analogs” areas; in particular a novel approach aggregating yields to focus on nutrition, assuming crop mix adaptation. Finally, to reach indicators relevant to human well-being, yields projections must be translated to benefit-relevant metrics, e.g., caloric sufficiency. The ecosystem service perspective invites to adopt a holistic view, both of the drivers, accounting for cohesive scenarios of changes, and of the response variable, integrating the demand-side.
abstract_zh: 农业景观对于粮食生产以及其他生态系统服务至关重要，生态系统服务是指生态系统向人类提供的各种重要惠益。本章综述了多种生态系统服务可能受到气候变化影响的方式，总体结论是，大多数影响往往是负面的，既影响农业生产的支持性服务，也影响农业生态系统的协同效益。本章考察了将粮食供给作为生态系统服务进行建模的系统性方法，同时纳入气候与社会变化；全球统计模型有望通过“气候类比”地区的产量响应来刻画气候影响，其中尤为新颖的是一种以营养为导向、假定作物结构可适应调整的产量汇总方法。最后，为了得到与人类福祉相关的指标，必须将产量预测转换为与福利相关的度量指标，例如热量充足度。生态系统服务视角促使我们采取整体性的观点，既要考虑驱动因素，纳入连贯一致的变化情景，也要考虑响应变量，纳入需求侧因素。

title: Projected landscape-scale repercussions of global action for climate and biodiversity protection
abstract: Land conservation and increased carbon uptake on land are fundamental to achieving the ambitious targets of the climate and biodiversity conventions. Yet, it remains largely unknown how such ambitions, along with an increasing demand for agricultural products, could drive landscape-scale changes and affect other key regulating nature’s contributions to people (NCP) that sustain land productivity outside conservation priority areas. By using an integrated, globally consistent modelling approach, we show that ambitious carbon-focused land restoration action and the enlargement of protected areas alone may be insufficient to reverse negative trends in landscape heterogeneity, pollination supply, and soil loss. However, we also find that these actions could be combined with dedicated interventions that support critical NCP and biodiversity conservation outside of protected areas. In particular, our models indicate that conserving at least 20% semi-natural habitat within farmed landscapes could primarily be achieved by spatially relocating cropland outside conservation priority areas, without additional carbon losses from land-use change, primary land conversion or reductions in agricultural productivity.
abstract_zh: 土地保护和陆地碳吸收的增加是实现气候和生物多样性公约中雄心勃勃目标的根本所在。然而，在目前情况下，这些雄心勃勃的目标连同日益增长的农产品需求，将如何推动景观尺度的变化，并影响保护优先区以外维持土地生产力的其他关键调节性自然贡献（NCP），在很大程度上仍不清楚。通过采用一种综合且全球一致的建模方法，我们发现，雄心勃勃的以碳为重点的土地恢复行动以及保护区的扩大，单独来看可能不足以扭转景观异质性、授粉供给和土壤流失的负面趋势。然而，我们也发现，这些行动可以与专门的干预措施相结合，后者能够支持保护区以外的关键自然贡献和生物多样性保护。具体而言，我们的模型表明，在农耕景观中至少保留20%的半自然栖息地，主要可以通过将耕地从保护优先区迁出来实现，而不会因土地利用变化、原生土地转化或农业生产力下降而额外造成碳损失。

title: Projecting global oil palm expansion under zero-deforestation commitments: Direct and indirect land use change impacts
abstract: In the last three decades, global production of oil palm has boomed, which has partly come at the expense of tropical rainforests. Recognizing this, many companies operating in the palm oil industry have committed to eliminate deforestation from their operations, often referred to as zero-deforestation commitments (ZDCs). Here, we estimate that if ZDCs are fully adopted and enforced across all sectors and geographies, the global extent of oil palm plantations may be 11 M ha or 40% smaller in 2030 than in a business-as-usual (BAU) scenario that assumes no compliance with ZDCs. As a result of such land-sparing effects, we estimate that 96 M ha of forests are saved from conversion, of which, 17% would otherwise have been converted (directly or indirectly) due to expanding oil palm plantations. Overall, these figures suggest that ZDCs have the potential to deliver major environmental benefits if they are fully adopted and enforced.
abstract_zh: 过去三十年间，全球棕榈油产量迅速增长，但这在一定程度上是以热带雨林为代价的。认识到这一点后，许多棕榈油行业企业承诺在其经营活动中消除毁林，这通常被称为零毁林承诺（ZDC）。在此，我们估计，如果零毁林承诺在所有行业和地区得到充分采纳和执行，到2030年，全球油棕种植面积可能比不遵守零毁林承诺的“照常发展”（BAU）情景小1100万公顷，即小40%。由于这种土地节约效应，我们估计有9600万公顷森林得以避免被转为他用，其中17%原本会因油棕种植园扩张而被直接或间接砍伐。总体而言，这些数字表明，如果零毁林承诺得到充分采纳和执行，将有可能带来重大的环境效益。

title: The meso scale as a frontier in interdisciplinary modeling of sustainability from local to global scales
abstract: Achieving sustainable development requires understanding how human behavior and the environment interact across spatial scales. In particular, knowing how to manage tradeoffs between the environment and the economy, or between one spatial scale and another, necessitates a modeling approach that allows these different components to interact. Existing integrated local and global analyses provide key insights, but often fail to capture ‘meso-scale’ phenomena that operate at scales between the local and the global, leading to erroneous predictions and a constrained scope of analysis. Meso-scale phenomena are difficult to model because of their complexity and computational challenges, where adding additional scales can increase model run-time exponentially. These additions, however, are necessary to make models that include sufficient detail for policy-makers to assess tradeoffs. Here, we synthesize research that explicitly includes meso-scale phenomena and assess where further efforts might be fruitful in improving our predictions and expanding the scope of questions that sustainability science can answer. We emphasize five categories of models relevant to sustainability science, including biophysical models, integrated assessment models, land-use change models, earth-economy models and spatial downscaling models. We outline the technical and methodological challenges present in these areas of research and discuss seven directions for future research that will improve coverage of meso-scale effects. Additionally, we provide a specific worked example that shows the challenges present, and possible solutions, for modeling meso-scale phenomena in integrated earth-economy models.
abstract_zh: 实现可持续发展需要理解人类行为与环境如何在不同空间尺度上相互作用。尤其是，要管理环境与经济之间、或不同空间尺度之间的权衡，就需要一种能够让这些不同组成部分相互作用的建模方法。现有的地方与全球综合分析提供了关键见解，但往往未能捕捉到在地方与全球之间尺度上运行的“中观尺度”现象，从而导致错误的预测和分析范围的局限。中观尺度现象由于其复杂性和计算上的挑战而难以建模，增加尺度往往会使模型运行时间呈指数级增长。然而，这些增加的尺度又是必要的，只有这样才能建立包含足够细节的模型，供政策制定者评估各种权衡。本文综合了明确纳入中观尺度现象的研究，并评估了哪些方面的进一步努力可能有助于改进我们的预测，并扩大可持续性科学能够回答的问题范围。我们重点讨论与可持续性科学相关的五类模型，包括生物物理模型、综合评估模型、土地利用变化模型、地球-经济模型和空间降尺度模型。我们概述了这些研究领域中存在的技术和方法挑战，并讨论了未来研究的七个方向，以期提升对中观尺度效应的覆盖面。此外，我们提供了一个具体的案例，展示了在地球-经济综合模型中对中观尺度现象进行建模所面临的挑战及可能的解决方案。

title: The missing markets link in global-to-local-to-global analyses of biodiversity and ecosystem services
abstract: While the impacts of global drivers such as international trade, population growth, technological development or climate change on local-level pricing, decision making, biodiversity and ecosystem services (BES) have received strong and increasing attention over the recent decades, relatively few studies have examined how impacts on local BES due to human activities or how local responses targeted to improve BES outcomes, can propagate to regional, national and global scale. We discuss the challenges that frequently arise in global-to-local-to-global frameworks when modelling policies aimed at improving land-use change while also maximising the associated benefits from the state of biodiversity and the provision of ecosystem services. We present four complexities associated with case studies that describe approaches to protecting BES in diverse landscapes and contexts within the proposed framework: heterogeneity in local markets; additionality; spillover and leakage effects; and unintended consequences. Our study calls for filling these gaps in our understanding through interdisciplinary, open-source research characterizing the local-to-global biodiversity and ecosystem services linkages in future.
abstract_zh: 尽管国际贸易、人口增长、技术发展或气候变化等全球性驱动因素对地方层面的价格、决策、生物多样性和生态系统服务（BES）的影响，在过去几十年中受到了越来越多的关注，但相对较少的研究考察了人类活动对地方生物多样性和生态系统服务的影响，或旨在改善生物多样性和生态系统服务成果的地方性应对措施，如何传导至区域、国家和全球尺度。我们讨论了在“全球—地方—全球”框架下建模政策时常出现的挑战，这些政策旨在改善土地利用变化，同时最大化由生物多样性状况和生态系统服务供给带来的相关效益。我们结合该框架，介绍了四个复杂性问题，它们与案例研究相关，这些案例描述了在不同景观和情境中保护生物多样性和生态系统服务的方法：地方市场的异质性、附加性、溢出与泄漏效应，以及非预期后果。我们的研究呼吁通过跨学科、开源的研究来填补这些认识上的空白，以刻画未来地方到全球的生物多样性和生态系统服务之间的联系。

title: Towards a better future for biodiversity and people: Modelling Nature Futures
abstract: The Nature Futures Framework (NFF) is a heuristic tool for co-creating positive futures for nature and people. It seeks to open up a diversity of futures through mainly three value perspectives on nature – Nature for Nature, Nature for Society, and Nature as Culture. This paper describes how the NFF can be applied in modelling to support decision-making. First, we describe key considerations for the NFF in developing qualitative and quantitative scenarios: i) multiple value perspectives on nature as a state space where pathways improving nature toward a frontier can be represented, ii) mutually reinforcing key feedbacks of social-ecological systems that are important for nature conservation and human wellbeing, iii) indicators of multiple knowledge systems describing the evolution of complex social-ecological dynamics. We then present three approaches to modelling Nature Futures scenarios in the review, screening, and design phases of policy processes. This paper seeks to facilitate the integration of relational values of nature in models and strengthen modelled linkages across biodiversity, nature’s contributions to people, and quality of life.
abstract_zh: “自然未来框架”（NFF）是一种启发式工具，用于共同构建自然与人类的美好未来。它力图通过三种主要的自然价值观视角来开拓多元的未来图景，即“为自然而自然”、“为社会而自然”以及“作为文化的自然”。本文阐述了如何在建模中应用NFF以支持决策。首先，我们阐述了在制定定性和定量情景时运用NFF的关键考虑因素：i）将自然的多重价值观视角作为一个状态空间，在其中可以表示使自然朝向前沿改善的路径；ii）对维持自然保护与人类福祉至关重要的社会-生态系统相互强化的关键反馈；iii）描述复杂社会-生态动态演变的多种知识体系指标。随后，我们提出了在政策过程的审查、筛选和设计阶段，对自然未来情景进行建模的三种方法。本文旨在促进将自然的关系性价值纳入模型，并加强生物多样性、自然对人类的贡献与生活质量之间的模型化联系。

title: A Conceptual Framework to Integrate Biodiversity, Ecosystem Function, and Ecosystem Service Models
abstract: Global biodiversity and ecosystem service models typically operate independently. Ecosystem service projections may therefore be overly optimistic because they do not always account for the role of biodiversity in maintaining ecological functions. We review models used in recent global model intercomparison projects and develop a novel model integration framework to more fully account for the role of biodiversity in ecosystem function, a key gap for linking biodiversity changes to ecosystem services. We propose two integration pathways. The first uses empirical data on biodiversity–ecosystem function relationships to bridge biodiversity and ecosystem function models and could currently be implemented globally for systems and taxa with sufficient data. We also propose a trait-based approach involving greater incorporation of biodiversity into ecosystem function models. Pursuing both approaches will provide greater insight into biodiversity and ecosystem services projections. Integrating biodiversity, ecosystem function, and ecosystem service modeling will enhance policy development to meet global sustainability goals.
abstract_zh: 全球生物多样性和生态系统服务模型通常是各自独立运行的。因此，生态系统服务预测可能过于乐观，因为它们往往没有考虑生物多样性在维持生态功能中的作用。我们回顾了近期全球模型比较计划中使用的模型，并提出了一种新颖的模型整合框架，以更充分地考虑生物多样性在生态系统功能中的作用，这是将生物多样性变化与生态系统服务联系起来的一个关键缺口。我们提出了两条整合路径。第一条路径利用生物多样性与生态系统功能关系的实证数据，将生物多样性模型与生态系统功能模型连接起来，目前即可在数据充分的系统和类群中于全球范围内实施。我们还提出了一种基于性状的方法，即在生态系统功能模型中更多地纳入生物多样性。同时推进这两种方法，将有助于深化对生物多样性和生态系统服务预测的理解。整合生物多样性、生态系统功能和生态系统服务建模，将加强政策制定，以实现全球可持续发展目标。

title: Agents on a Landscape: Simulating Spatial and Temporal Interactions in Economic and Ecological Systems
Increasing the uptake of ecological model results in policy decisions to improve biodiversity outcomes
Ecosystem service modelling
venue: The Routledge Handbook of Research Methods for Social-Ecological Systems
abstract: Chapter 31 concerns ecosystem service modelling, which refers to methods used to quantify ecosystem services, the benefits from nature that support and fulfil human life. The chapter discusses the decision-support modelling packages (integrated valuation of ecosystem services and trade-offs), artificial intelligence for ecosystem services and Co$ting Nature/Waterworld, as well as other technical models and frameworks. The latter include integrated assessment models, general equilibrium models, Lund–Potsdam–Jena Dynamic Global Vegetation Model and Life Cycle Assessment models. The chapter goes on to discuss the types of social-ecological systems (SES) problems and research questions commonly addressed by this set of methods, as well as their limitations, resource implications and new emerging research directions. It also includes an in-depth case study showcasing the application of ecosystem service modelling, and suggested further readings.
abstract_zh: 第31章讨论生态系统服务建模，即用于量化生态系统服务的方法，生态系统服务指支撑和维系人类生活的自然惠益。本章讨论了决策支持建模软件包（生态系统服务与权衡的综合评估，InVEST）、生态系统服务的人工智能方法，以及Co$ting Nature/Waterworld，并介绍了其他技术模型和框架。后者包括综合评估模型、一般均衡模型、Lund–Potsdam–Jena动态全球植被模型和生命周期评价模型。本章进一步讨论了这一组方法通常处理的社会-生态系统（SES）问题类型和研究问题，以及它们的局限性、资源需求和新兴的研究方向。本章还包括一个深入的案例研究，展示生态系统服务建模的应用，并列出了推荐的延伸阅读文献。

title: Energy matters: Mitigating the impacts of future land expansion will require managing energy and extractive footprints
abstract: Understanding potential future patterns of human-induced land-use and land-cover change is critical to assessing and proactively managing the tradeoffs between development and the environment. Most global land-use change assessments, however, consider a narrow set of economic sectors, focusing primarily on agricultural and urban sectors. We present a global land-use change model that includes detailed energy and mining sectors (11 in total) in addition to agriculture and urban sectors. We find that energy and extractive sectors had a large expansion footprint (1.26 million km2) projected to 2050, which was nearly as large as the cropland expansion footprint (1.54 million km2) and larger than the urban expansion footprint (0.34 million km2). Moreover, energy and mining expansion account for nearly 80% of all projected expansion into the world's most intact natural lands, suggesting that these sectors play an outsized role in threats to biodiversity and environmental protection. Additionally, we find substantial shifts in the ranking of countries in relation to their vulnerability of land conversion when we accounted for energy and mining footprints alongside agricultural and urban footprints. Our results suggest that meeting resource demands, while maintaining social and environmental benefits provided by natural systems, will require reducing consumption and increasing efficiency in resource use alongside improved development siting and mitigation practices.
abstract_zh: 理解人类活动引起的土地利用和土地覆被变化的未来潜在格局，对于评估和主动管理发展与环境之间的权衡至关重要。然而，大多数全球土地利用变化评估只考虑少数经济部门，主要集中于农业和城市部门。我们提出了一个全球土地利用变化模型，除农业和城市部门外，还包括详细的能源和采矿部门（共11个）。我们发现，能源和采掘部门的扩张足迹较大，预计到2050年将达到126万平方千米，这一数字几乎与耕地扩张足迹（154万平方千米）相当，并且大于城市扩张足迹（34万平方千米）。此外，能源和采矿扩张约占预计进入世界上最完整自然土地的全部扩张的80%，表明这些部门在对生物多样性和环境保护的威胁中发挥着不成比例的作用。另外，当我们将能源和采矿足迹与农业和城市足迹一并纳入考虑时，各国在土地转换脆弱性方面的排名发生了显著变化。我们的结果表明，要满足资源需求，同时维持自然系统所提供的社会和环境效益，需要减少消费、提高资源利用效率，并改进发展选址和缓解措施。

title: Increasing decision relevance of ecosystem service science
Lessons learned from development of natural capital accounts in the United States and European Union
Closing yield gap is crucial to avoid potential surge in global carbon emissions
Global modeling of nature's contributions to people
Mapping Ecosystem Services to Human Well-being: a toolkit to support integrated landscape management for the SDGs
Mapping global development potential for renewable energy, fossil fuels, mining and agriculture sectors
abstract: Mapping suitable land for development is essential to land use planning efforts that aim to model, anticipate, and manage trade-offs between economic development and the environment. Previous land suitability assessments have generally focused on a few development sectors or lack consistent methodologies, thereby limiting our ability to plan for cumulative development pressures across geographic regions. Here, we generated 1-km spatially-explicit global land suitability maps, referred to as “development potential indices” (DPIs), for 13 sectors related to renewable energy (concentrated solar power, photovoltaic solar, wind, hydropower), fossil fuels (coal, conventional and unconventional oil and gas), mining (metallic, non-metallic), and agriculture (crop, biofuels expansion). To do so, we applied spatial multi-criteria decision analysis techniques that accounted for both resource potential and development feasibility. For each DPI, we examined both uncertainty and sensitivity, and spatially validated the map using locations of planned development. We illustrate how these DPIs can be used to elucidate potential individual sector expansion and cumulative development patterns.
abstract_zh: 绘制适宜开发的土地图谱，对于旨在建模、预判和管理经济发展与环境之间权衡的土地利用规划至关重要。以往的土地适宜性评估通常只关注少数发展部门，或缺乏统一的方法，从而限制了我们对不同地理区域累积发展压力进行规划的能力。在此，我们生成了1公里空间精度的全球土地适宜性地图，称为“发展潜力指数”（DPI），涵盖与可再生能源（聚光太阳能、光伏太阳能、风能、水电）、化石燃料（煤炭、常规与非常规石油和天然气）、采矿（金属矿、非金属矿）以及农业（作物、生物燃料扩张）相关的13个部门。为此，我们应用了空间多准则决策分析技术，同时考虑了资源潜力和开发可行性。对于每个发展潜力指数，我们都考察了其不确定性和敏感性，并利用规划开发项目的位置对地图进行了空间验证。我们举例说明了如何利用这些发展潜力指数，来揭示各部门单独的潜在扩张模式以及累积的发展格局。

title: Social-ecological and technological factors moderate the value of urban nature
Voluntary sustainability standards could significantly reduce detrimental impacts of global agriculture
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Voluntary sustainability standards (VSS) may be an effective way to reduce the negative impacts of agriculture at regional to global scales. Here, we present an approach that highlights the potential of VSS to reduce some of the negative externalities associated with agriculture production. To illustrate this potential, we show that VSS could reduce the global environmental impacts from growing sugarcane. Further, most of this environmental benefit comes from targeting just 10% of production area. To realize these environmental gains, incentives for VSS adoption need to be sufficient to cover the costs of criteria compliance. Determining these costs and public and private-sector mechanisms for efficiently transferring VSS-adoption subsidies to farmers and millers are key future research needs.
abstract_zh: 自愿可持续性标准（VSS）可能是在区域到全球尺度上减少农业负面影响的有效途径。在此，我们提出了一种方法，突出了自愿可持续性标准在减少农业生产相关负外部性方面的潜力。为说明这一潜力，我们表明，自愿可持续性标准可以减少种植甘蔗对全球环境造成的影响。此外，这一环境效益大部分来自仅针对10%生产面积的措施。要实现这些环境收益，必须为采纳自愿可持续性标准提供足够的激励，以覆盖遵守各项标准的成本。确定这些成本，以及公共和私营部门高效地将采纳自愿可持续性标准的补贴转移给农户和糖厂的机制，是未来研究的关键需求。

title: A protocol for an intercomparison of biodiversity and ecosystem services models using harmonized land-use and climate scenarios
abstract: To support the assessments of the Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services (IPBES), the IPBES Expert Group on Scenarios and Models is carrying out an intercomparison of biodiversity and ecosystem services models using harmonized scenarios (BES-SIM). The goals of BES-SIM are (1) to project the global impacts of land use and climate change on biodiversity and ecosystem services (i.e. nature’s contributions to people) over the coming decades, compared to the 20th century, using a set of common metrics at multiple scales, and (2) to identify model uncertainties and research gaps through the comparisons of projected biodiversity and ecosystem services across models. BES-SIM uses three scenarios combining specific Shared Socio-economic Pathways (SSPs) and Representative Concentration Pathways (RCPs) to explore a wide range of land-use change and climate change futures. This paper describes the rationale for scenarios selection, the process of harmonizing input data for land use, based on the second phase of the Land Use Harmonization Project (LUH2), and climate, the biodiversity and ecosystem service models used, the core simulations carried out, the harmonization of the model output metrics, and the treatment of uncertainty. The results of this collaborative modelling project will support the ongoing global assessment of IPBES, strengthen ties between IPBES and the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) scenarios and modelling processes, advise the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) on its development of a post-2020 strategic plans and conservation goals, and inform the development of a new generation of nature-centred scenarios.
abstract_zh: 为支持政府间生物多样性和生态系统服务科学政策平台（IPBES）的评估工作，IPBES情景与模型专家组正在利用统一情景开展生物多样性和生态系统服务模型的比较研究（BES-SIM）。BES-SIM的目标是：（1）在未来几十年内，使用一套共同的多尺度指标，相对于20世纪，预测土地利用和气候变化对生物多样性和生态系统服务（即自然对人类的贡献）的全球影响；（2）通过比较各模型对生物多样性和生态系统服务的预测，识别模型的不确定性和研究空白。BES-SIM采用三种情景，分别结合特定的共享社会经济路径（SSP）和代表性浓度路径（RCP），以探索广泛的土地利用变化和气候变化未来。本文介绍了情景选择的依据、基于土地利用协调项目第二阶段（LUH2）的土地利用输入数据和气候数据的协调过程、所使用的生物多样性和生态系统服务模型、开展的核心模拟、模型输出指标的协调，以及对不确定性的处理。这一合作建模项目的结果将支持IPBES正在进行的全球评估，加强IPBES与政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）情景和建模过程之间的联系，为《生物多样性公约》（CBD）制定2020年后战略规划和保护目标提供建议，并为开发新一代以自然为中心的情景提供信息。

title: Distilling the role of ecosystem services in the Sustainable Development Goals
The Natural Capital Accounting Opportunity: Let's Really Do the Numbers
Multi-site interactions: Understanding the offsite impacts of land use change on the use and supply of ecosystem services
Global Food Demand and Carbon-Preserving Cropland Expansion under Varying Levels of Intensification
abstract: Increasing demand for agricultural crops and a decline in the rate of yield improvements will require expansion of cropland (extensification), resulting in a loss of carbon storage. This paper uses global, spatially explicit data to analyze how extensification can be located to meet crop demand in a way that minimizes carbon losses under varying levels of intensification. Carbon-preserving extensification can reduce carbon loss by 7.3 billion tons compared to proportionally increasing extensification by 2050, valued at $1.3 trillion (2012 dollars) based on an estimated social cost of carbon of $181 per ton of carbon (∼$50 per ton CO2). (JEL Q18, Q24)
abstract_zh: 农作物需求的增长以及单产提高速度的下降，将要求扩大耕地面积（粗放式扩张），从而导致碳储存量的损失。本文利用全球空间明确的数据，分析在不同集约化水平下，如何布局粗放式扩张以满足作物需求，并使碳损失最小化。与按比例增加粗放式扩张相比，到2050年，保碳型粗放式扩张可减少73亿吨碳损失，按每吨碳的社会成本181美元（约合每吨二氧化碳50美元）估算，价值1.3万亿美元（以2012年美元计）。（JEL：Q18，Q24）

title: Greenhouse gas emissions intensity of global croplands
Managing forest ecosystem services for hydropower production
abstract: In many countries, hydropower development is rapidly becoming a focus of green growth policies. This represents a significant opportunity for ecosystem services-based land management that integrates environmental and development goals to benefit the hydropower sector and support economic growth. In this study, we present an approach for targeting ecosystem-provision investment in hydropower catchments coupled with hydrologic modeling to quantify the benefits of soil and water conservation activities. We demonstrate the application of this approach in five hydropower facility catchments in the state of Himachal Pradesh, India. The results show that there is a high potential for targeted soil and water conservation to increase sediment retention services that benefit hydropower facilities (up to a 44% reduction in sediment transported from uplands into streams), although this benefit is distributed non-uniformly across catchments and levels of investment. The extent to which services can be improved is strongly driven by current land use and management practices that impact how and where conservation activities can be located. Iterative use of the method described here, in a process of stakeholder engagement and capacity-building, enables policy makers to determine the optimal mix of land management strategies and budget allocation to maximize service improvements that support hydropower production.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，水电开发正迅速成为绿色增长政策的重点。这为基于生态系统服务的土地管理提供了重要机遇，这种管理将环境目标与发展目标相结合，以惠及水电行业并支持经济增长。在本研究中，我们提出了一种方法，用于确定水电流域中生态系统供给型投资的目标，并结合水文建模，量化水土保持活动的效益。我们在印度喜马偕尔邦的五个水电站流域中应用了这一方法。结果表明，有针对性的水土保持措施具有很大潜力，可增强惠及水电设施的泥沙滞留服务（使从高地流入溪流的泥沙最多减少44%），不过这一效益在不同流域和不同投资水平之间分布并不均匀。服务能够得到改善的程度，很大程度上取决于当前的土地利用和管理实践，这些实践影响着保护活动能够在何处、以何种方式开展。通过利益相关方参与和能力建设中反复运用本文所述的方法，政策制定者能够确定最优的土地管理策略组合和预算分配，以最大化支持水电生产的服务改善。

title: Inclusive wealth as a metric of sustainable development
venue: Annual Review of Environment and Resources
abstract: Inclusive wealth is a measure designed to address whether society is on a sustainable development trajectory. Inclusive wealth is defined as the aggregate value of all capital assets. Increases in inclusive wealth indicate an improved productive base capable of supporting a higher standard of living in the future. To be truly inclusive, measures of inclusive wealth must include the value of all forms of capital that contribute to human well-being: human capital, manufactured capital, natural capital, and social capital. Sustainability concerns have increased attention on the ways of measuring the value of natural capital. We review various attempts to measure natural capital and to incorporate these into inclusive wealth including estimates using national wealth accounts and integrated ecological and economic models used to estimate ecosystem services. Empirically measuring the value of various types of capital in terms of a common metric is hugely challenging, and no current attempt to date can be said to be fully inclusive. Despite the empirical challenges, inclusive wealth provides a clear, coherent, and systematic framework for addressing sustainable development. Combining measures of semi-inclusive wealth that capture forms of capital that can be relatively easily measured in monetary terms with a set of biophysical metrics capturing important aspects of natural capital that are difficult to measure in monetary terms may provide a good set of signals of whether society is proceeding along a sustainable development trajectory.
abstract_zh: 包容性财富是一种旨在判断社会是否处于可持续发展轨道上的度量指标。包容性财富被定义为所有资本资产的总价值。包容性财富的增加表明生产基础得到改善，能够支撑未来更高的生活水平。要真正做到包容，包容性财富的度量必须涵盖所有有助于人类福祉的资本形式：人力资本、人造资本、自然资本和社会资本。对可持续性的关注，使人们越来越重视如何衡量自然资本的价值。我们综述了衡量自然资本并将其纳入包容性财富的各种尝试，包括利用国民财富核算的估算，以及用于估算生态系统服务的综合生态与经济模型。以统一的度量单位来实证衡量各类资本的价值极具挑战性，迄今为止，尚无任何现有尝试可称为完全包容。尽管存在实证上的挑战，包容性财富仍为应对可持续发展问题提供了清晰、连贯和系统的框架。将能够较容易以货币计量的资本形式所构成的半包容性财富指标，与一组捕捉自然资本中难以用货币计量的重要方面的生物物理指标相结合，或许能够提供较好的信号，判断社会是否正沿着可持续发展的轨迹前进。

title: Spatial patterns of agricultural expansion determine impacts on biodiversity and carbon storage
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Deforestation is a major threat to biodiversity and many ecosystem services and is closely linked to agricultural expansion. Sustainability assessment of different agricultural products and policies requires an understanding of the impacts of land conversion resulting from shifts in demand or incentives for production. The prevailing approaches to estimating such impacts do not account for the spatial context of the transformation. This study shows how different patterns of agricultural expansion into forested landscapes can vastly reduce or exacerbate the total impact, suggesting that methods to measure sustainability should consider not only the total area but also where and how the landscape is converted.
abstract_zh: 森林砍伐是对生物多样性和许多生态系统服务的主要威胁，并与农业扩张密切相关。要评估不同农产品和政策的可持续性，需要理解由生产需求或激励变化所引起的土地转换影响。目前估算此类影响的主流方法并未考虑转换的空间背景。本研究表明，农业向森林景观扩张的不同格局，可以极大地减轻或加剧总体影响，这表明衡量可持续性的方法不仅应考虑总面积，还应考虑土地在何处以及以何种方式被转换。

title: Are we in this together? Risk bearing and collective action
venue: Journal of Natural Resources Policy Research

title: Global agriculture and carbon trade-offs
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: We assess how to meet growing demand for agricultural production to minimize impact on the environment. Higher levels of population and affluence may require expanding land in agriculture by converting grasslands and forests to cropland. Such conversions often reduce valuable ecosystem services. Our research identifies where are the best places to expand agricultural production that minimize the loss of one ecosystem service, carbon storage. We show that selectively choosing where to expand agriculture saves over $1 trillion (2012 US dollars) worth of carbon storage relative to a proportional expansion.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了如何在满足日益增长的农业生产需求的同时，将对环境的影响降到最低。更高的人口水平和富裕程度，可能需要通过将草地和森林转为耕地来扩大农业用地。此类转换往往会削弱宝贵的生态系统服务。我们的研究确定了最佳的农业扩张地点，以使一种生态系统服务即碳储存的损失最小化。我们发现，与按比例扩张相比，有选择地确定农业扩张的地点，可节约价值超过1万亿美元（以2012年美元计）的碳储存量。

title: Assessing the comparative productivity advantage of bioenergy feedstocks at different latitudes
